items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: It was Lester Young, Buddy Rich and guess the piano player.

ctx.x: I want to say positive. There’s some negative because it’s not far off — I mean what a crazy thing — I now get to say I’m from a generation where when I was learning there was no cell phones, there was no internet connection, there was no media. All we had were records and tapes and cassettes and 50% slowdown playback. And hopefully the resources landed in front of us from someone that was able to share, I don’t know, the right way to sift through a library or a record store or something, for us to get the…

know what I mean? All of it is a learning tool that is very strong. And it’s kind of about sifting through it. Now they just have way more to sift through, just like media. We have way more to sift through. And it’s easy to get things covered up. It’s funny because a student of mine played me, he did a listening test on me and I completely failed it. It was Lester Young, Buddy Rich and guess the piano player. You’d never guess the piano player. And it was a trio from like 1942.
